title: Problem with selecting AAPS folder
symptom: AAPS is giving error message about not selected AAPS folder. When trying to select it from settings, the user gets: "Unable to launch activity. This is an Android issue".
cause: The issue is caused by Family Link parental controls blocking the activity launch.
fix: The thread does not provide a specific fix, but the maintainer indicates that Family Link is blocking the call in Android.
evidence_quote: it's blocking this call in android
